display.name: Neon Stack Performance
display.description: Native Metal timing summaries correlated with builds. Use local Instruments traces for detailed diagnosis.

display.name: Frame preparation wall time
display.description: Elapsed CPU-side frame preparation, including waits. This is not CPU utilization. Each point averages window p95 values.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, (attributes->>'recorded_at')::timestamp) AS time, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, avg((attributes->>'cpu_frame_p95_ms')::double) AS milliseconds FROM records WHERE service_name IN ('xcode-observe', 'neon-stack') AND span_name = 'game.performance.window' GROUP BY time, session ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000

display.name: Metal command GPU time p95
display.description: Window summaries plotted at measurement time. Each series identifies a session. Offscreen runs measure a paced texture loop; onscreen runs measure renderer callbacks.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, (attributes->>'recorded_at')::timestamp) AS time, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, avg((attributes->>'gpu_command_p95_ms')::double) AS milliseconds FROM records WHERE service_name IN ('xcode-observe', 'neon-stack') AND span_name = 'game.performance.window' GROUP BY time, session ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000

display.name: Compare like-for-like runs
display.description: Average window p95 is not an overall p95. Match seed, drawable size, build commit, Mac model, OS, and profiler mode. Offscreen runs measure a paced texture loop; onscreen runs measure renderer callbacks. Use a known build trace to distinguish uncommitted build artifacts. Match Aurora layer count.

spec.query: SELECT w.attributes->>'render_mode' AS mode, coalesce(w.attributes->>'aurora_layers', '0') AS aurora_layers, w.attributes->>'workload' AS workload, s.attributes->>'game.seed' AS seed, s.attributes->>'game.instrumented' AS instrumented, w.attributes->>'drawable_width' AS width, w.attributes->>'drawable_height' AS height, s.attributes->>'host.model' AS mac_model, s.attributes->>'host.macos_version' AS macos, s.attributes->>'git.commit' AS commit, s.attributes->>'build.trace_id' AS build_trace, count(DISTINCT w.trace_id) AS sessions, count(*) AS windows, avg((w.attributes->>'frame_interval_p95_ms')::double) AS mean_window_interval_p95_ms, avg((w.attributes->>'gpu_command_p95_ms')::double) AS mean_window_gpu_p95_ms FROM records w JOIN records s ON w.trace_id = s.trace_id AND s.span_name = 'game.session' AND s.kind = 'span' WHERE w.service_name = 'xcode-observe' AND w.span_name = 'game.performance.window' GROUP BY mode, aurora_layers, workload, seed, instrumented, width, height, mac_model, macos, commit, build_trace ORDER BY mean_window_gpu_p95_ms DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Native performance windows
display.description: Percentiles cover individual five-second windows after warmup. Callback FPS is not presented FPS. Offscreen runs measure a paced texture loop; onscreen runs measure renderer callbacks.

spec.query: SELECT attributes->>'recorded_at' AS measured, attributes->>'render_mode' AS mode, attributes->>'workload' AS workload, (attributes->>'render_callback_fps')::double AS render_rate_hz, (attributes->>'frame_interval_p95_ms')::double AS interval_p95_ms, (attributes->>'cpu_frame_p95_ms')::double AS cpu_p95_ms, (attributes->>'gpu_command_p95_ms')::double AS gpu_command_p95_ms, (attributes->>'frames_over_25_ms')::bigint AS intervals_over_25_ms, (attributes->>'lines')::bigint AS lines, attributes->>'thermal_state' AS thermal_state, trace_id FROM records WHERE service_name IN ('xcode-observe', 'neon-stack') AND span_name = 'game.performance.window' ORDER BY attributes->>'recorded_at' DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Game sessions
display.description: Fixed-seed replay. Profiled sessions include Instruments overhead. Offscreen runs measure a paced texture loop; onscreen runs measure renderer callbacks.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp AS exported, attributes->>'game.render_mode' AS mode, attributes->>'game.workload' AS workload, attributes->>'game.seed' AS seed, attributes->>'game.instrumented' AS instrumented, attributes->>'game.windows' AS windows, attributes->>'host.model' AS mac_model, attributes->>'git.commit' AS commit, attributes->>'build.trace_id' AS build_trace, trace_id FROM records WHERE service_name = 'xcode-observe' AND span_name = 'game.session' AND kind = 'span' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Renderer callback interval p95
display.description: Window summaries plotted at measurement time. Each series identifies a session. Offscreen runs measure a paced texture loop; onscreen runs measure renderer callbacks.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, (attributes->>'recorded_at')::timestamp) AS time, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, avg((attributes->>'frame_interval_p95_ms')::double) AS milliseconds FROM records WHERE service_name IN ('xcode-observe', 'neon-stack') AND span_name = 'game.performance.window' GROUP BY time, session ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000

display.name: Live Swift operations
display.description: Native operations arrive during ordinary Xcode runs. Join independent windows by session_id. Nested operations share a trace.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp, span_name, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'render_mode' AS mode, attributes->>'cleared_lines' AS cleared_lines, attributes->>'all_clear' AS all_clear, trace_id FROM records WHERE service_name = 'neon-stack' AND kind = 'span' AND span_name != 'game.performance.window' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Apple display delivery
display.description: Presented frames and frame-on-glass intervals come from Apple. CPU and GPU wall times are durations, not hardware utilization.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'build.id' AS build, (attributes->>'presented_fps')::double AS presented_fps, (attributes->>'frame_on_glass_mean_ms')::double AS glass_interval_mean_ms, (attributes->>'gpu_wall_mean_ms')::double AS gpu_wall_mean_ms, (attributes->>'drawable_wait_mean_ms')::double AS drawable_wait_mean_ms, attributes->>'game.native.states' AS native_states FROM records WHERE span_name = 'game.native.performance' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: App build identities
display.description: Cmd-R records app identity. Wrapped xcodebuild records full build timing. Join runtime records by build.id.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp, span_name, attributes->>'build.id' AS build, attributes->>'build.configuration' AS configuration, attributes->>'build.sdk' AS sdk, attributes->>'xcode.version' AS xcode, attributes->>'git.commit' AS commit, attributes->>'build.source_digest' AS source_digest, trace_id FROM records WHERE span_name IN ('xcode.build.identity','xcode.build') AND kind = 'span' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Native captures attached to sessions
display.description: Artifacts remain on the recording Mac. Use capture.path to open the native recording and manifest locally.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp, attributes->>'capture.id' AS capture, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'build.id' AS build, attributes->>'build.trace_id' AS build_trace, attributes->>'capture.started_at' AS capture_start, attributes->>'capture.ended_at' AS capture_end, attributes->>'capture.path' AS local_artifact, attributes->>'capture.storage' AS storage FROM records WHERE span_name = 'game.profile.capture' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Apple lookback measurements
display.description: Selected per-layer summaries from on-demand captures. No live observer is required. Detailed recordings stay local.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp, attributes->>'capture.id' AS capture, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'build.id' AS build, attributes->>'presented_fps' AS presented_fps, attributes->>'gpu_wall_mean_ms' AS gpu_wall_mean_ms, attributes->>'drawable_wait_mean_ms' AS drawable_wait_mean_ms, attributes->>'game.native.states' AS states FROM records WHERE span_name = 'game.native.capture_summary' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
